Who we are


## A cross-border firm with one HR department


Melbourne Capital Group is a fast-growing financial services firm with a workforce of around 60 employees, 50% of whom are expatriates. In Malaysia, our footprint spans four key locations: Kuala Lumpur, Penang, Johor and Labuan, alongside our international office in Thailand. Managing complex expatriate documentation, multi-location compliance and cross-border operations is critical as we prepare for further international expansion.


Operating as a standalone HR department, I manage the full employee lifecycle across all locations: talent acquisition, onboarding, regulatory compliance, expatriate mobility, reporting and internal communications. To support our scale, we required an all-in-one HR platform capable of centralising these disparate functions, eliminating manual overhead and delivering reliable data insights to leadership.


Life before brioHR


## Fragmented systems, manual bottlenecks


### Fragmented reporting


Data had to be manually pulled and reconciled across multiple disjointed systems to produce even basic reports.


### Complex expatriate management


Immigration records, visas and compliance deadlines were tracked by hand, increasing the risk of oversight.


### Manual probation tracking


Probation end dates depended entirely on manually generated reports, with no automated alerts, so key deadlines were easy to miss.


### Onboarding friction


HR was the manual bridge between departments, coordinating every minor setup detail directly with IT and Administration.


These inefficiencies significantly restricted HR capacity, limiting our ability to focus on strategic initiatives, employee engagement and regional growth plans.


The transformation


## High-impact results across five locations


30%


### Reduction in manual workload


Centralising core processes into a single source of truth dramatically lowered administrative burden and freed up strategic capacity.


Alerts


### Automated probation & milestone tracking


System-generated notifications keep crucial timelines on track, eliminating missed review deadlines and manual checks.


Analytics


### Seamless reporting & compliance


Automated analytics give management real-time visibility into headcount trends and operational metrics, making compliance auditing effortless.


Mobility


### Structured expatriate mobility


Centralised document repositories and automated record-keeping minimise regulatory risk and streamline cross-border operations.


ESS


### Cross-departmental automation


Employee Self-Service lets new hires manage their own data, while automated workflows assign tasks to IT and Admin, so onboarding runs without constant HR intervention.


## Looking Ahead


brioHR has elevated HR from a tactical, administrative function to a strategic enabler at Melbourne Capital Group, creating a scalable foundation for our multi-location operations. As we expand, we plan to unlock further value:


### Hybrid & WFH attendance


Monitor work-from-home schedules and keep visibility over distributed regional teams.


### Continuous performance


Move from static annual reviews to ongoing goal tracking and performance alignment.


### Document templates


Ready-made letters to automate contracts, increment notices and confirmations.


“brioHR has taken HR at Melbourne Capital Group from tactical administration to a strategic enabler, with a foundation that scales as we grow across borders.”


**Fazilah** · Group Head of HR, Melbourne Capital Group
